Name: Familiars
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[size=5][b]Familiar Types[/b][/size]

There are five types of familiar at the moment:

[b]Dust[/b] - a [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Dust_Sprite]Dust Sprite[/url] familiar
[list]
[*]is bouncy
[*]squeaks
[*]destroys rocks
[*]steals stuff from monsters
[/list]
[b]Dino[/b] - a [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Pepper_Rex]Pepper Rex[/url] familiar
[list]
[*]is swol
[*]breathes fire at monsters
[/list]
[b]Bat[/b] - a [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Bats]Bat [/url]familiar
[list]
[*]flappy
[*]squeaky
[*]bites monsters
[/list]
[b]Junimo[/b] - a [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Junimos]Junimo[/url] Familiar
[list]
[*]cuddly
[*]meepy
[*]heals owner's health and stamina periodically when nearby
[/list]
[b]Butterfly[/b] - a Butterfly Familiar
[list]
[*]floppy
[*]floaty
[*]gives owner a random buff periodically when nearby
[/list]

[b][size=5]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Familiars default to following their owners everywhere you go, warping when you warp. They are invincible (though explosives might kill them).
[*]Familiars start out tiny and grow every day they exist until they get very big.
[*]Familiars start out very weak but gain experience ﻿every time they use their abilities and slowly get stronger.
[*]You can stop a familiar from following you if you have a Slime Hutch. When you are in the Slime Hutch, click on the familiar and it will stay put.
[*]To summon all familiars to you, type [b]SummonFamiliars[/b] or [b]SF[/b] in the console.
[*]To dispel (destroy) all familiars in the current location, type [b]DispelFamiliars[/b] or [b]DF[/b] or in the console.
[/list]

[size=5][b]Getting Familiars (The Official Way)[/b][/size]

To acquire a familiar, you need to incubate and hatch a familiar egg in the [b]Slime Incubator[/b].

Getting familiar eggs is not an easy task! Read [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/452]here [/url]if you want hints on how to get them. Read [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/453]here [/url]if you want explicit instructions.

Once you have the egg, place it in the Slime Incubator and wait.


[size=5][b]For Cheaters[/b][/size]

To directly summon a familiar if you have enabled cheats in the config file, you need to use the SMAPI console. Just click on the console and type the following:

[b]CF <FamiliarType>[/b]

where [b]<FamiliarType>[/b] is one of "[b]Bat[/b]", "[b]Dino[/b]", "[b]Dust[/b]", "[b]Junimo[/b]", or "[b]BF[/b]".

So to call a bat familiar, type:

[b]CF Bat[/b]

then press [b]Enter[/b].

To get a Familiar Egg, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿.


[size=5][b]Customization[/b][/size]

You can colour your familiars as well or set custom texture paths (useful for Content Patcher packs) using the config file. There are colourable textures in the mod's asset folder for all except the Junimo and Butterfly. If you want to use them, just set the following values in the config file:

  "BatTexture": "Characters/Monsters/BatFamiliar",
  "DinoTexture": "Characters/Monsters/DinoFamiliar",
  "DustTexture": "Characters/Monsters/DustSpiritFamiliar",
  "BatColorType": "custom",
  "DinoColorType": "custom",
  "DustColorType": "custom",

and then edit the color values in the config as you like (they are in RGBA 0-255 notation). You can also set the ColorType entries to "random" and each familiar will get random coloring, according to the following:

There are up to four colours per familiar, one main colour that replaces greys with shades of that color, and three colours that replace pure red, green, and blue in the texture files.

For Junimo, there is only one colour, mainColor. Setting [b]JunimoColorType[/b] to "default" uses the game's default set of random Junimo colors. Setting it to "random" makes the Junimo's color truly random. Setting it to "custom" makes it use the [b]JunimoMainColor[/b] config setting.


[size=5][b]Future Plans[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Make a familiar call whistle.
[*]Implement feeding.
[/list]
[b]
[size=5]Technical[/size][/b]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url]. Uses Harmony.

Apparently [b]does not[/b] work well in multiplayer.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
